messages:
sophia: Quick sync after the streaming postmortem — thanks everyone who dug in last night. The doc lists repeated patterns: timeouts clustering at tail latency, client reconnect storms, and undetected partial responses. Need a compact remediation playbook + owners by EOD Friday.

miguel: I'll take the client-side part: tightening reconnect windows, adding exponential jitter, and a graceful polling fallback. My plan: draft PR with unit + e2e that simulates delayed tokens. ETA: Wed EOD.

oliver: I'll own server-side controls: adaptive heartbeat jitter, a simple session backpressure metric, and a server-side short-circuit after N fast reconnects. Should have a prometheus metric and a dashboard by Thu.

anya: I'll write an integration that replays partial-burst traces from the incident and asserts fallback triggers. Also will add a local harness to reproduce corrupt-chunk ordering. ETA: Thu noon.

infra-bot: Incident 385002 opened: streaming-recurrence-detection-2026-03-21. Tagging reliability oncall.

rachel: I'll coordinate the rollout gating and comms. Canary plan: 5% traffic first, monitor streaming.partial_responses.rate and token-latency P95 for 2h, then 25% if stable. Target kickoff: Fri 09:00 UTC.

sophia: good. can we also add a short retro note about recurring patterns so the SRE playbook can catch regressions automatically?

oliver: yes — I'll add a rule to the metrics repo: if partial_responses.rate increases 2x baseline and token-latency P95 increases >200ms within 15m, open a P0 ticket.

miguel: For the fallback behavior: default threshold 10s without a token, then switch to polling. Make it overrideable via request param and a global feature flag. I'll include telemetry events: fallback_triggered and fallback_reason.

anya: product asked whether polling fallback is acceptable UX-wise. We should include a short customer message. Sophia, can you own that?

sophia: yep, I'll draft two blurbs: one for status page + one for dedicated customers. Will post examples by Thu EOD.

infra-bot: Weekly reliability sync reminder: Mon 11:00. Please add remediation status as agenda item.

rachel: Regarding alerts: temp threshold for canary is 1% partial_responses over 10m. Post-canary we'll tune to 0.5%. I'll file the alert change and own tuning after metrics stabilize.

miguel: code sketch for SDK reconnect (will attach in PR):
```js
function computeBackoff(attempt){
  return Math.min(10000, Math.floor(200 * Math.pow(2, attempt)) + jitter());
}
if (msSinceLastChunk > fallbackMs) { sendTelemetry('fallback_triggered'); startPolling(); }
```

oliver: Implementation note: server-side short-circuit should mark sessions with label `reconnect_burst=true` to avoid reattaching to noisy clients. Also will add `session_loss_mode` label to exporter (network|backpressure|unknown).

anya: scheduling: daily status posts here until all items closed. If anyone hits a blocker, escalate to @sre and @oncall.

sophia: ACTIONS roundup for postmortem doc (one-line each):
- Miguel: SDK reconnect + polling fallback (PR Wed EOD, canary Fri 09:00).
- Oliver: Server heartbeat jitter + reconnect_burst circuit + metrics/dashboard (PR Thu, deploy Thu night).
- Anya: Integration harness + regression test from incident traces (test Thu noon).
- Rachel: Canary gating & alert tuning + customer comms coordination (plan Thu AM, execute Fri).

infra-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-27 09:00 UTC for canary (owner: rachel).

miguel: starting work on branch now. I'll post PR link when ready and ping @deploy-bot for canary.

rachel: I'll report canary health at 1h and 3h marks in this thread.

oliver: will share dashboard screenshots and the prometheus rule link in the next message.

sophia: thanks all. keep updates succinct here. Important: try to get telemetry events shipped with the SDK fix so we can evaluate fallback frequency quickly. :thumbsup:
